facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Peter came home. He was tired and sick. Mother Rabbit saw him. Mother helped him.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Peter finally arrived home, tired and scared. He had lost his jacket and his shoes in the garden. His stomach hurt from eating too many vegetables. Mother Rabbit saw poor little Peter at the door. She held him gently in her warm arms. Mother helped him feel safe and warm again.
facts.Word cards: mother = 엄마 / helped = 도와줬다 / home = 집 / sick = 아픈
